# Lab 12.1: Your First Model: Linear Regression

## What We Are Going to Do
Train a linear regression model in SQL to predict a penguin's body mass, evaluate it, and make predictions.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab12</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Train the model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.penguins_lr
OPTIONS (
  model_type = 'LINEAR_REG',
  input_label_cols = ['body_mass_g'],
  data_split_method = 'AUTO_SPLIT'
) AS
SELECT species, island, culmen_length_mm, culmen_depth_mm, flipper_length_mm, sex, body_mass_g
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ml_datasets.penguins`
WHERE body_mass_g IS NOT NULL;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Look at training.** Open `lab12 → Models → penguins_lr`. Check the **Training** tab (loss per iteration) and the **Evaluation** tab (MAE, RMSE, R²).

4. **[SQL] Evaluate.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab12.penguins_lr);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[SQL] Predict.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT predicted_body_mass_g, species, island, flipper_length_mm
FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL lab12.penguins_lr,
  (SELECT 'Adelie Penguin (Pygoscelis adeliae)' AS species, 'Biscoe' AS island,
          39.0 AS culmen_length_mm, 18.0 AS culmen_depth_mm, 190.0 AS flipper_length_mm, 'MALE' AS sex));</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Model | `lab12.penguins_lr` |
| R² | Around 0.8 or higher |
| Prediction | `predicted_body_mass_g` column |
| Weights | One weight per feature (and per category) |
